related.title: AMReX：局部細化與有效格點預算
related.titleEn: AMReX: local refinement and active-cell budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付skin幾何、位移監控與重建/步長區辨測試；10/15可重算，記相對位移理由且不把安全邊界當建議最大性能設定；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver skin geometry, displacement monitoring, and tests separating rebuild and timestep problems. Reproduce 10 and 15 with the relative-motion rationale. Do not present the boundary as an optimized production setting. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫十個粗區塊其中一個細化為八子格，分開標有效、覆蓋及ghost類型；1700/2400正確，常數場體積總量守恆，儲存與有效量分欄。
related.differenceEn: Draw ten coarse regions with one replaced by eight children. Label active, covered, and ghost categories separately. Verify 1700 and 2400 with constant-field conservation. Report storage separately from active cells.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 保守教學判準為每粒子移動不超skin/2，因兩粒子可能相向；不是所有設定的唯一重建規則；合成skin=.4距離單位，速度上限.02單位/步；改skin=.6，速度固定；名義式 (.4/2)/.02 = 10 steps to half-skin displacement；變更式 (.6/2)/.02 = 15 steps to half-skin displacement。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

三維粗格N中比例f以每軸r倍細化，有效格數N(1−f)+Nfr³；覆蓋粗格不重複當有效；合成N=1000、f=.1、r2；改f=.2，無ghost cells；名義式 1000*(1-.1)+1000*.1*2**3 = 1700 active cells；變更式 1000*(1-.2)+1000*.2*2**3 = 2400 active cells。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A conservative teaching criterion limits each particle to half the skin because two particles can approach each other. Actual policies have additional conditions. Synthetic skin = 0.4 distance units and maximum motion = 0.02 units per step; compare skin = 0.6 at the same motion rate. Nominal (.4/2)/.02 = 10 steps to half-skin displacement; changed (.6/2)/.02 = 15 steps to half-skin displacement. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

For refined fraction f and per-axis ratio r, active 3 D cells equal N(1−f) + N f r³. Covered coarse cells are excluded from active counts. Synthetic N = 1000, f = 0.1, r = 2; compare f = 0.2, excluding ghost cells. Nominal 1000*(1-.1)+1000*.1*2**3 = 1700 active cells; changed 1000*(1-.2)+1000*.2*2**3 = 2400 active cells. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: RAJA：執行政策與歸約所有權
related.titleEn: RAJA: execution policies and reduction ownership

related.difference: 畫四組[1,2]、[3,4]、[5,6]、[7,8]的私有部分和3、7、11、15，再單次加入初值；46/36與四部分和吻合，輸入被消費一次且初值唯一。
related.differenceEn: Draw partial sums 3, 7, 11, and 15 from four pairs, then add the initializer once. Verify 46 and 36, with each input consumed once and only one initializer.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 保守教學判準為每粒子移動不超skin/2，因兩粒子可能相向；不是所有設定的唯一重建規則；合成skin=.4距離單位，速度上限.02單位/步；改skin=.6，速度固定；名義式 (.4/2)/.02 = 10 steps to half-skin displacement；變更式 (.6/2)/.02 = 15 steps to half-skin displacement。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
sum結果為初值s0加每個輸入一次；若每工作者重複加入非零初值，結果會偏移；合成輸入1..8，初值s0=10；改s0=0，工作分四組；名義式 10+8*9/2 = 46 sum；變更式 8*9/2 = 36 sum。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: A conservative teaching criterion limits each particle to half the skin because two particles can approach each other. Actual policies have additional conditions. Synthetic skin = 0.4 distance units and maximum motion = 0.02 units per step; compare skin = 0.6 at the same motion rate. Nominal (.4/2)/.02 = 10 steps to half-skin displacement; changed (.6/2)/.02 = 15 steps to half-skin displacement. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

The result is one initial value plus each input exactly once. Repeating a nonzero initializer per worker changes the answer. Synthetic inputs 1 through 8 with initial value 10 versus 0, partitioned into four groups. Nominal 10+8*9/2 = 46 sum; changed 8*9/2 = 36 sum. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
